literature.abstract: Humans can also be infrequent infected by Pasteurella bettyae. We report the first association of P. bettyae with urethritis and balanitis in men who have sex with men practicing unprotected intercourse.

literature.title: Treating gonococcal urethritis in men: oral amoxycillin potentiated by clavulanate compared with intramuscular procaine penicillin.
literature.journal: The British journal of venereal diseases
literature.abstract: In a study of 121 men with uncomplicated gonococcal urethritis, 64 were treated orally with a single dose of 3 g amoxycillin and 250 mg of the specific beta-lactamase inhibitor, clavulanic acid, and 57 with a single intramuscular injection of 2.4 MU procaine penicillin. After seven days, six (9.4%) patients treated with amoxycillin and clavulanic acid were still culture positive for Neisseria gonorrhoeae, compared with 26.3% of those treated with procaine penicillin.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Neisseria gonorrhoeae 可產生 penicillinase（PPNG 株），導致 amoxicillin 失效。Clavulanic acid 不可逆抑制 β-lactamase，與 amoxicillin 合用（Augmentin）可恢復對 PPNG 的殺菌活性，機轉邏輯明確。然而 1980 年代後淋病治療指引已轉向 ceftriaxone（因更廣泛耐藥性），歷史證據的現代臨床適用性需重新評估。

literature.title: Chest wall actinomycosis in association with the use of an intra-uterine device.
literature.journal: The Australian and New Zealand journal of surgery
literature.abstract: A 31 year old woman presented with a chest wall abscess due to Actinomyces israellii and Porphyromonas asaccharolytica (previously Bacteroides asaccharolyticus). She was a long-term user of an intra-uterine device (IUD) and, although asymptomatic, had radiological evidence of pelvic infection. Actinomyces-like organisms were seen on cervico-vaginal smears. The abscess was surgically drained, the IUD removed, and a prolonged course of amoxycillin/clavulanic acid given.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 子宮炎性疾病（子宮內膜炎、骨盆腔炎）常為多菌感染，包含可產生 β-lactamase 的細菌（MRSA 除外之金黃色葡萄球菌、部分腸桿菌科）。Amoxicillin-clavulanate 在 CNGOF 產後子宮內膜炎指引（PMID 30890463）中被列為治療選項，具備指引層級支持。然而大多數文獻為動物研究或間接人類資料，人類 RCT 證據不足，需要現代臨床試驗驗證。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 黃色肉芽腫性腎盂腎炎（XGP）主要由 Proteus mirabilis 或 E. coli 引起（部分可產生 β-lactamase），理論上存在一定機轉相關性。然而 XGP 治療核心為手術切除（腎切除術），抗生素僅為輔助且通常需廣效覆蓋。現有文獻僅為影像診斷病例報告，無 clavulanic acid 的直接治療證據，暫不建議推進。

clinical_trials.title: The HYsteroscopic Miscarriage MaNagement (HYMMN) Trial
clinical_trials.brief_summary: Pregnancy tissue can be found remaining in the womb in up to 20% of women following a miscarriage. These "retained products of conception" (RPOC), which are diagnosed by transvaginal ultrasound, can cause prolonged bleeding, pain, infection, impaired fertility and therefore further psychological distress. Ineffective medical and surgical interventions place considerable burden on affected women and utilise scarce health care resources. Additionally, surgery is performed 'blindly' using a suction

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 腹部異位妊娠為外科急症，標準治療為手術切除或 methotrexate（葉酸拮抗劑）。Clavulanic acid 為 β-lactamase 抑制劑，對滋養層細胞增殖無任何已知作用機轉，機轉邏輯根本上不成立。TxGNN 高分（0.9980）可能源於知識圖譜中「婦科疾病–感染–抗生素」節點的非特異性路徑連結，屬典型假陽性。
腹腔幹壓迫症候群（Dunbar syndrome / Median arcuate ligament syndrome）為解剖結構性血管壓迫，主要治療為手術解壓。Clavulanic acid 對血管壓迫無任何已知作用機轉，零臨床或文獻支持。TxGNN 評分屬圖譜非特異性預測，不具備生物學合理性。
腹部囊性淋巴管瘤為先天性淋巴管畸形，主要治療為手術切除或硬化療法。Clavulanic acid 對淋巴管瘤的增殖或退縮無已知作用機轉，零臨床或文獻支持。
淋巴結柵欄狀肌纖維母細胞瘤（palisaded myofibroblastoma）為罕見良性腫瘤，主要治療為手術切除。Clavulanic acid 對間葉性腫瘤無已知作用機轉，無任何臨床或文獻支持，評估應終止。
子宮闊韌帶疾病涵蓋多種異質性病理（囊腫、肌瘤、感染性等）。若為感染性病因（如闊韌帶膿瘍），amoxicillin-clavulanate 有理論上的機轉邏輯，但現有輸入資料中無任何臨床試驗或文獻支持，且病因異質性高，評估暫不推進。
